import click
from click.testing import CliRunner

@click.command()
@click.option('-c', '--choice', type=click.Choice(['Apple', 'Banana']))
def cli(choice):
    click.echo('got:%s' % choice)

r = CliRunner()
res = r.invoke(cli, ['-c', 'APPLE'])
assert res.exit_code != 0, res.output
assert 'Invalid value' in res.output or 'invalid choice' in res.output, res.output
res2 = r.invoke(cli, ['-c', 'Apple'])
assert res2.exit_code == 0, res2.output
assert res2.output.strip() == 'got:Apple', res2.output
print('ok')
